yt_title: Build a live satellite tracker with a free API
caption:
POV: you build your first real app this weekend.

Tool of the day: the N2YO API. Free key when you sign up. It tells you which satellites are above any spot on Earth (100 of those lookups an hour on the free key).

1. Make an N2YO account, generate your key
2. Ask an AI coding tool to build a page showing what's overhead where you live
3. Publish it and put it in your portfolio

APIs are the skill behind most automations people pay for.
